name: Holos Monorepo Toolchain
description: Development toolchain for the Holos monorepo. Tools, runtimes, and CI pipeline that support building, testing, linting, and releasing Alistigo packages.

nodes.name: Developer / AI Agent
nodes.description: Human developer or Claude Code AI agent writing and reviewing code in the monorepo

nodes.name: pnpm Workspace
nodes.description: Package manager and workspace orchestrator. Manages node_modules with content-addressable store. workspace:* protocol for local package cross-references.

interfaces.name: pnpm CLI
interfaces.description: pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm qa

nodes.name: Nx Build Orchestration
nodes.description: Build pipeline with task caching, affected analysis, and dependency graph. project.json is the single source of truth for all Nx tasks (build, typecheck, test, lint, clean, dev). Delegates to underlying tools.

interfaces.name: Nx CLI
interfaces.description: nx run <project>:<target>, nx affected -t build, nx run-many -t test

nodes.name: Bun Runtime
nodes.description: TypeScript runtime inside individual apps/packages. Used for dev servers, test execution, and build scripts. Not used at browser runtime.

interfaces.name: Bun CLI
interfaces.description: bun run, bun test, bun build

nodes.name: Biome (Lint + Format)
nodes.description: Unified linting and formatting replacing ESLint + Prettier. biome.json at repo root. All code must pass `pnpm biome check --write .` before commit.

nodes.name: TypeScript (strict)
nodes.description: Type checker. Strict mode: strict, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noUncheckedIndexedAccess. All packages extend tsconfig.base.json. No `any` without justification comment.

nodes.name: dependency-cruiser (arch-check)
nodes.description: Architectural linting at the code level. Validates package imports against declared rules (.dependency-cruiser.cjs). Enforces layer isolation. See docs/arch-check.md.

nodes.name: Fallow (dead-code + complexity)
nodes.description: Dead-code detection and code complexity analysis. pnpm qa:dead-code for full scan; pnpm qa:audit for changed-file fast gate. MCP server available for AI-assisted analysis.

nodes.name: mise (tool versions)
nodes.description: Tool version manager. Pins node, bun, python, rust. .mise.toml at repo root.

nodes.name: Vitest (unit tests)
nodes.description: Unit test runner for packages. Run via Nx task: nx run <project>:test.

nodes.name: Playwright (E2E)
nodes.description: End-to-end browser automation. Used by list-features-runner-playwright for iframe-level Gherkin tests.

nodes.name: GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
nodes.description: CI pipeline running on push/PR. Runs QA checks, builds, tests, and releases. Publishes packages to npm on release tags. See .github/workflows/.

nodes.name: Lefthook (git hooks)
nodes.description: Git hook manager. Runs biome format and other checks on pre-commit/pre-push. lefthook.yml at root.

nodes.name: CALM Toolchain
nodes.description: Architecture as Code tooling. @finos/calm (CLI validate/generate), @finos/calm-studio (browser editor), @finos/calm-mcp (MCP server for Claude Code and VS Code). See ADR 0027.

interfaces.name: CALM CLI
interfaces.description: pnpm calm validate, pnpm calm generate

interfaces.name: CALM MCP Server
interfaces.description: Provides architecture context to Claude Code and VS Code AI tools

interfaces.name: calm-studio
interfaces.description: Browser-based interactive CALM editor at localhost during development

relationships.description: Developer uses pnpm to install deps, run tasks, and manage the workspace
Root package.json scripts delegate to nx run-many for orchestration
Nx invokes bun for individual package build, test, and dev targets
Nx qa:lint target delegates to Biome
Nx typecheck target delegates to tsc --noEmit
Nx qa:arch-check target delegates to dependency-cruiser
Nx qa:dead-code and qa:audit targets delegate to Fallow CLI
Nx test target delegates to Vitest
Nx e2e target in list-features-runner-playwright delegates to Playwright
CI pipeline runs Nx tasks (nx affected -t build,test,lint,typecheck)
Pre-commit hook runs biome format and check
Developer and Claude Code use CALM CLI to validate architecture files; calm-studio to browse/edit them
CI runs pnpm qa:arch-calm to validate CALM files on every PR
